glossary.name: Jarl
glossary.simpleEnglish: A northern regional ruler or lord
glossary.explanation: A high-ranking noble ruling over a province, fortress hold, and sworn huscarls in the Northern Realms.
glossary.significance: Holds sovereign authority over regional laws, garrisons, and judicial trials.

glossary.name: Huscarl
glossary.simpleEnglish: A sworn personal bodyguard or elite veteran warrior
glossary.explanation: Veteran warriors bound by sacred blood-oath to defend their Jarl and hold unto death.
glossary.significance: Renowned for their unbreakable shield-walls and heavy iron plate.

glossary.name: Draugr
glossary.simpleEnglish: Undead warrior haunting ancient barrows and ruins
glossary.explanation: Animated ancestral corpses guarding burial crypts with ancient rusted blades and chthonic frost magic.
glossary.significance: Deadly subterranean foes resistant to mundane cold.

glossary.name: Runecraft
glossary.simpleEnglish: The art of inscribing magical runes into metals and stone
glossary.explanation: The northern art of channeling primordial storm and frost energy into weapons, armor, and gate-wards.
glossary.significance: Essential for breaking ancient seal-doors and battling eldritch wyrms.

glossary.name: Sky-Iron
glossary.simpleEnglish: Meteoric ore found in snowbound mountain crags
glossary.explanation: Dense, resonant celestial metal prized by master smiths for forging legendary relic weapons.
glossary.significance: The only material capable of piercing the hide of ancient dragons.
